title: Godot 4.5 beta6 'export template download' keeps failing and forcing me to restart from scratch (to fail again)
body:
### Tested versions

-

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

Both tried in browser and in godot windows app. It fails and can't continue where it left off. It is also very slow 1.1 mb at best so can't download before it fails. 

### Steps to reproduce

Just try to download it from both app and browser.
